step1_analysis.description: A basic NMOS differential pair, likely serving as the transconductance stage for a mixer or an amplifier in the 1.9-GHz front-end receiver.

paper_reference.title: Low-Voltage 1.9-GHz Front-End Receiver in 0.5-m CMOS Technology

sky130_expected.calculation: With 1mA tail current, Id=0.5mA per branch. W/L=10, Vov approx 0.6V, gm = 2*Id/Vov = 1.66mS. With 1kOhm load, Av = gm*R = 1.66 V/V = 4.4 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load resistor and tail current in the testbench.

bandwidth_3db.description: Frequency at which the differential gain drops by 3 dB

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2*pi*Rload*Cout). With Rload=1k and Cout approx 10-20fF, f_3dB > 10 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The intrinsic bandwidth of the bare transistors with a 1k load is very high, well above the 1.9 GHz operating frequency.

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the testbench circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the 1mA ideal tail current source and 1.8V supply.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for NMOS differential pair measuring DC power, differential gain, and 3dB bandwidth.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Differential Pair
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 LABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Biasing and Loads
VDD vdd 0 1.8
R1 vdd LABEL_NET_0 1k
R2 vdd LABEL_NET_2 1k
I_tail N0 0 1m

* Inputs
Vcm vcm 0 1.2
V_in_p LABEL_NET_1 vcm dc 0 ac 0.5
V_in_n LABEL_NET_3 vcm dc 0 ac -0.5

* Differential to Single-Ended Converter for easy measurement
E1 out_diff 0 LABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_2 1

.control
op
let pwr = 1.8 * -i(VDD)
print pwr

ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

print max_gain bw_3db
quit
.endc
.end
